name: Lieke Vermeer
bio:
Lieke's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood visits to the Zandvoort circuit. She was captivated by the intricate technology that powered the racing machines. This fascination led her to pursue a degree in Electrical Engineering at Delft University of Technology. During her studies, she gained practical experience through internships with Formula Student teams, specializing in telemetry and data analysis.

Lieke approaches her work with a meticulous and systematic mindset, ensuring that every electronic component functions optimally. Her goal is to push the boundaries of vehicle performance through innovative electronic solutions. She distinguishes herself with her ability to quickly diagnose and resolve complex electrical issues under pressure, making her a valuable asset to any racing team. Her focus is on squeezing every last drop of performance from a car's electronics systems.

She is eager to prove herself in a demanding role and contribute to a winning team. She is not afraid to challenge the status quo and embraces new technologies to gain a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: shoulder-length, wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Lieke is petite with a focused gaze and often wears practical, comfortable clothing.

quirks: Always carries a small multimeter in her backpack.
Has a habit of humming classical music while soldering.
Keeps a meticulously organized electronic component library on her laptop.
